60701.symptom: CANNOT REACH PyPI. `uv pip install -e .` sat 31 min at 3.5% CPU with 3 packages in site-packages and 96 cores idle at load 10; site-packages static across 45 s and `curl files.pythonhosted.org` returned 0 B/s. Provisioning never finished, so no stage log and no cells. Discriminator is the runbook's: static is a state, growing is a race -- and the shape reads as a slow box, not a broken one, which is why it ran 45 min before anyone asked.

31849.symptom: ssh silent for 6 min after create
31849.withdrawn: WITHDRAWN 2026-09-11, SAME DAY. Blocklisted on 'ssh silent for 6 min after create' during a burst launch of SIX boxes 4 seconds apart. All four had NO mapped 22/tcp port in the instance record when the launcher gave up, while the two that survived the same burst had real ports. Relaunched 60 s apart, three boxes sat at port=None for one 5-minute tick and ALL THREE had mapped ports and were running by the next -- so the port assignment completes, and 6 minutes is too short for a burst create rather than these hosts being bad. A wrongly blocklisted machine leaves the offer pool permanently, so the entry is withdrawn rather than left standing on a symptom that reproduced on healthy hosts.

11541.symptom: BANDWIDTH DEGRADES UNDER LOAD, and it reads as a race the whole time. uv cache DID keep growing -- 1548 -> 2067 -> 2131 -> 2465 MB -- so the growing-is-a-race discriminator said healthy at every check, while the RATE fell 4.4 -> 1.4 -> 0.89 MB/s across 20 minutes and the venv never finished. The disqualifier is not that it stalled, it is that this box carried 20 models whose weights are ~300 GB: at 0.89 MB/s that is ~92 hours. Growth is the right test for STALLED; it is the wrong test for TOO SLOW TO FINISH, and those need different responses.
